tasks.short: Write technical reports on water resources and use efficiency.

steps.what: Gather figures for the water use efficiency reports.
Draft the technical reports from the checked figures.

loop.input: Figure pack and the report headings
loop.output: Draft that cites each figure's source record
loop.check: A sentence whose number is not in the pack is deleted
loop.stop: One draft; headings with no figure stay for the engineer
loop.why_not_simpler: The prose has to follow this study's figures, not a previous report

steps.what: Check every figure in the technical reports.
Publish the technical reports.

tasks.design: Figures are gathered from {BI} and {DOCS} into a pack, and a draft is written only from that pack. The engineer checks every figure before anything is published. Publication uses the {CMS} or the document store only for the checked version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were rewritten from the last one, and numbers were pasted without a source.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can be filled once every number has a record. The check and the decision to publish stay.
tasks.still_hard: A sentence that is fluent and still says more than the figures support.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer stops a claim the study did not make.

ambition.what: Give operators the same checked figures as the external report, in a short note, not only the published document.

tasks.altitude: The check stays on the week. The engineer can refuse to publish a report with an unsourced number.

reach.task: Trace a reported result back to the record that produced it
reach.learn: Which trace is enough before a number is published

evidence.claim: The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
A report can be drafted from records, and every number still has to trace to a record the engineer signs.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from result tables to a published technical report. Doing the underlying study is out of scope.
Test {DOCS} templates and {BI} exports before custom code.
Structured fields are figure identity, value, unit and source record. The study record produces them. Fallback: the engineer types a figure and it cannot be published until a source is named.
Publishing is gated on the checked version.
unknowns: Whether the report is public or client-only.
research_questions: Which claims need a new calculation rather than a sentence?

already_counted.description: Checking figures and claims before publication
Editing the draft where the pack is thin

incremental.description: Keep report headings and source fields aligned

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A study with a complete figure pack saves most of the gathering and the first draft. The check stays, and a report that argues beyond the figures stays slow. The low case is a publication with new claims.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design water storage tanks and storage facilities.

steps.what: Set the water storage basis for the tanks.
Calculate volumes for the water storage tanks.
Civil engineer checks foundations for the storage tanks.
Lay out the storage tanks and their pipework.
Walk the storage tanks site before issue.
Issue the water storage design.

loop.input: Volume sheet, layout and site notes
loop.output: Issue note with volume, turnover and layout version
loop.check: Engineer checks volume against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a volume not on the sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must match this basis, not a copied tank

tasks.design: The storage basis is a decision, and tank volume is then calculated in {SPREADSHEET}. A civil engineer checks the foundation. The engineer still lays out the tanks and walks the site. The design is issued only when the volume matches that basis.
tasks.previous_blocker: Storage volumes were copied from the last tank and adjusted by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Volume follows from demand, fire reserve and turnover. Layout and the site stay.
tasks.still_hard: A volume that meets the hours of storage and will not fit or turn over on this site.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not issue a tank the ground and the pipework cannot serve.

ambition.what: Check fire storage and turnover before the tank is drawn, on every facility, not only when the fire service comments.

tasks.altitude: Layout and site walks stay. The engineer can hold an issue with a blank basis or a foundation note still open.

reach.task: Check tank foundation and wall loads
reach.learn: Which ground conditions make the volume's footprint unacceptable

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from storage basis to the issued tank design. Structural design of the wall is the civil engineer's work.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code.
Structured fields are average demand, fire volume, turnover hours and resulting volume. The demand sheet produces demand. Fallback: a missing fire requirement blocks the volume.
Laying out pipework and walking the site are not calculations.
unknowns: Whether one tank or several compartments are required.
research_questions: Which sites need a geotechnical check before the footprint is fixed?

already_counted.description: Setting the basis when demand and fire reserve conflict

incremental.description: Keep fire and turnover rules current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A clear demand and fire rule save the volume pass. Basis conflicts, layout and the site walk stay. The low case is a site with no ground information.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend sludge treatment or disposal methods.

steps.what: Analyze sludge quantities and the treatment history.
List disposal methods the rules allow.

loop.input: Waste rules and the sludge sheet
loop.output: Route list: method, constraint and rule reference
loop.check: Engineer checks each constraint against the rule
loop.stop: One pass; a route with no rule reference is open
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules are prose and thresholds, not a menu of methods

steps.what: Judge which sludge disposal methods are lawful here.
Disposal contractor confirms the route and the permit.
Recommend the sludge disposal method.

loop.output: Recommendation naming the method, the permit and the open condition
loop.check: Engineer checks the permit reference before send
loop.stop: One draft; a route the judgement rejected is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must cite the rule, not only the contractor's offer

tasks.design: Sludge quantities are lined up in {SPREADSHEET}, and allowed routes are read from the rules into a list. The engineer still judges which disposal method is lawful here. The recommendation cites the rule and is sent only after that check. A cross-border hazardous shipment stays on the electronic procedure, not in the note alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quantities and waste rules were reread from scratch for every recommendation.
tasks.enabler_now: Quantities and stated thresholds can be listed first. Lawfulness of a route stays a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A route that meets a number and still fails a permit condition or a hazardous classification.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not sign a method the sludge quality does not support.

ambition.what: Stop a disposal route that misses a waste threshold before the contractor is asked to confirm it.

tasks.altitude: The judgement stays. The engineer can refuse a recommendation with no rule reference.

reach.task: Check that a waste record matches the batch that was produced
reach.learn: Which quality fields must be present before a route is even listed

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Cross-border hazardous waste shipments follow an electronic procedure.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from sludge logs and waste rules to a signed disposal recommendation. Design of a sludge plant is a separate task.
Test {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS} fields before custom code.
Structured fields are dry solids, contaminant, quantity, method and rule reference. The plant log produces quantity. Fallback: a blank contaminant blocks that route.
The contractor's confirmation is not the engineer's decision.
unknowns: Whether the sludge is hazardous on this result.
Which permits the contractor actually holds.
research_questions: Which methods need a trial burn or a land test the rules do not settle?

already_counted.description: Judging routes the threshold list leaves open
Checking the recommendation against the rule

incremental.description: Update contaminant thresholds when the waste rules change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A stable sludge with numeric rules saves the quantity pass and the route list. The lawfulness judgement stays. The low case is a sludge whose classification is disputed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather the sludge load for the treatment plants.

loop.output: Load basis: solids, flow, volatile fraction and limit
loop.check: Engineer checks each figure against the source
loop.stop: One pass; a blank solids figure blocks sizing
loop.why_not_simpler: Load records and permits are not one table

steps.what: Size sludge thickeners and digesters.
Size the dewatering units for the sludge.
Lay out the sludge treatment plants.
Check the liquor return to the main treatment plant.
Walk the sludge plant site.
Issue the sludge treatment design.

loop.input: Sizing sheets, liquor check and site notes
loop.output: Issue note with unit sizes and the layout version
loop.check: Engineer checks each size against the sheets
loop.stop: One draft; a size not on a sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must include the liquor return, not only the new units

tasks.design: Sludge load becomes a basis, and thickener, digester and dewatering sizes are calculated in {SPREADSHEET}. Liquor return to the main plant is checked as a load. The engineer still lays out the plant and walks the site. The issue is checked against those sheets.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sludge units were sized in a private workbook that did not show the liquor returning to the main plant.
tasks.enabler_now: Unit volumes follow from solids and flow. Layout and the site stay.
tasks.still_hard: A dewatering size that works alone and overloads the main plant with liquor.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer fits the units on the site and will not ignore the return load.
tasks.altitude: Plant layout stays. The engineer can hold an issue when solids are blank or the liquor check is open.

reach.task: Select dewatering machines for a stated sludge duty
reach.learn: Which machine limits the calculated size cannot assume away

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from sludge load to the issued sludge-plant design. Choosing a disposal route is a separate task.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code.
Structured fields are solids, flow, volatile fraction, unit type and size. The load record produces solids and flow. Fallback: blank solids block sizing.
Layout and the site walk are not the sizing sheet.
unknowns: Whether digestion is required or only thickening and dewatering.
What liquor the main plant can accept.
research_questions: Which sludges need a lab dewatering test before the machine is sized?

already_counted.description: Checking issued sizes and the liquor return
Reviewing layout where units will not fit

incremental.description: Keep sizing factors aligned with the firm's sludge types

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A known sludge saves the extract and the unit sizing. Layout, liquor surprises and the site walk stay. The low case is a sludge with no solids data.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reports, tanks, sludge routes and sludge plants still depend on the engineer. Draft text and repeated sizing take less time than they do now.
reach: Validation engineers on tracing a number to a record
skills_to_grow: Publishing only figures that have a source
Stopping a disposal route that fails a waste threshold
Checking liquor return before a sludge plant is issued
role.ambitious_version: Operators can see the same checked figures as a publication, and a disposal route that fails a threshold never reaches the contractor.
